easy.label: Easy
easy.blurb: The Academy, Team 7 and the rules of the world. Not free points.
easy.spoiler: Safe through the first arcs of Part 1.

questions.q: What rank are Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura when Team 7 forms?
questions.note: The lowest rank there is. Kakashi is a jonin.

questions.q: What is a jinchuriki?
a: A person with a tailed beast sealed inside them
A ninja who has mastered sage mode
questions.note: There are nine, and most of them are treated appallingly.

questions.q: What is Kakashi's first test for Team 7?
a: Surviving in the Forest of Death
questions.note: Two bells, three students. The point was to notice that.

questions.q: What is chakra made from?
a: Physical energy and spiritual energy combined
Natural energy drawn from the ground
questions.note: Which is why exhaustion and concentration both matter.

questions.q: Which clan technique lets its user swap places with an enemy's mind?
questions.note: Ino's clan. Miss and you spend a while inside a tree.

questions.q: Who is Konohamaru?
questions.note: The first person to take Naruto seriously as a teacher.

questions.q: What does Kakashi summon?
questions.note: Pakkun does the talking and complains about his paws.

questions.q: Which two villages attacked the Leaf during the Chunin Exams?
questions.note: The Sand had been misled — the Kazekage was already dead.

questions.q: Who is Rock Lee's teacher?
questions.note: Same haircut, same eyebrows, same worldview.

questions.q: What does Gaara carry on his back?
questions.note: The sand moves on its own to protect him. Nobody taught it to.

questions.q: Who becomes the Fifth Hokage?
questions.note: Dragged back to the village by a thirteen-year-old with a bet.

questions.q: What is the Aburame clan's technique?
a: They host colonies of insects in their bodies
questions.note: The bugs eat chakra, which makes Shino a nightmare matchup.

questions.q: What exam does the Forest of Death belong to?
a: The second stage of the Chunin Exams
questions.note: Five days, two scrolls, and Orochimaru wandering around in it.

questions.q: What is the Sharingan best known for?
questions.note: That, and seeing movement slowly enough to answer it.

questions.q: Which tailed beast is inside Naruto?
questions.note: Kurama, sealed the night Naruto was born.

questions.q: What is the tree-climbing exercise for?
questions.note: Too little and you fall, too much and you blow the bark off.

medium.label: Medium
medium.blurb: The Sannin, the Akatsuki, and the first half of Shippuden.
medium.spoiler: Spoilers through Pain's assault on the Leaf.

questions.q: What does Orochimaru actually want from Sasuke?
a: A new body to take over
An heir for the Sound village
questions.note: He changes bodies every three years. Sasuke was next in line.

questions.q: Which technique does the Third Hokage use against Orochimaru?
questions.note: It costs the user their life and only gets the arms.

questions.q: Who are the Sound Four?
questions.note: Each one nearly kills a member of the retrieval squad.

questions.q: Which Akatsuki member captures Gaara?
questions.note: On a clay bird, mostly to prove a point about art.

questions.q: Who dies bringing Gaara back to life?
questions.note: Her own life for his, and an apology decades late.

questions.q: What is Yamato's ability, and where does it come from?
a: Ice Release, from the Yuki clan
questions.note: One of sixty test subjects. The only survivor.

questions.q: Which organisation is Sai from?
questions.note: Danzo's private force, where they take your name and your feelings.

questions.q: Who kills Asuma?
questions.note: Through a ritual circle drawn in blood, which is how the immortality works.

questions.q: How many hearts does Kakuzu have?
questions.note: Taken from ninja he has killed. Each one is a separate fight.

questions.q: Which technique finally kills Kakuzu?
questions.note: It shredded him on a cellular level, and Naruto's arm with him.

questions.q: Who kills Jiraiya?
questions.note: In the rain, writing the last message on Fukasaku's back.

questions.q: What are Pain's six bodies?
questions.note: Which is why they never speak to each other.

questions.q: What did Minato seal inside Naruto?
a: Half of Kurama — the other half went into himself
questions.note: The Yin half went with him into the Reaper's stomach.

questions.q: What is Sage Mode?
a: Gathering natural energy while perfectly still
questions.note: Move while gathering and you turn into a frog. Permanently.

questions.q: Who is Konan to Nagato and Yahiko?
a: The third member of their original team
An Akatsuki recruit who came later
questions.note: Jiraiya taught all three of them.

questions.q: What is Kisame's sword Samehada able to do?
questions.note: And it chooses its wielder, which becomes a problem for him.

hard.label: Hard
hard.blurb: The Fourth Great Ninja War, the Otsutsuki and the machinery behind it.
hard.spoiler: Spoilers for the entire series, ending included.

questions.q: Which of the Sage of Six Paths' sons do the Uchiha descend from?
questions.note: The Senju come from Ashura. The argument has been running ever since.

questions.q: Who performs the Reanimation Jutsu during the war?
questions.note: After absorbing Orochimaru's remains and much of Sasuke's team.

questions.q: What does Izanagi cost the user?
a: The eye it is cast with
questions.note: Which is why Danzo needed a whole arm of them.

questions.q: Which Hokage invented Edo Tensei?
questions.note: He also forbade it, for all the good that did.

questions.q: What can Hashirama's Wood Release do that nothing else can?
questions.note: Which is why every villain in the series wants his cells.

questions.q: Who gives Naruto and Sasuke their Six Paths powers?
questions.note: A conversation with a dead man, mid-fight.

questions.q: What is Sasuke's Amenotejikara?
a: Swapping places with anything in sight
questions.note: The Rinnegan trick he uses most, and the one people forget.

questions.q: What was Kaguya's purpose for the Infinite Tsukuyomi?
a: Turning everyone into White Zetsu for her army
questions.note: The dream is the harvest, not the point.

questions.q: Whose will is Black Zetsu?
questions.note: A thousand-year plan to get his mother back, played through everyone.

questions.q: What happens to Might Guy after the Eighth Gate?
a: He survives, with a leg he can never use properly again
He is fully healed by Naruto
questions.note: Naruto's Six Paths chakra stopped his heart from finishing the job.

questions.q: What power does Kakashi briefly receive in the war?
a: Both of Obito's eyes and Six Paths chakra
questions.note: A complete Susanoo, for one fight only.

questions.q: Which arms do Naruto and Sasuke lose at the Valley of the End?
questions.note: Sasuke refuses a replacement. Naruto takes one made of Hashirama cells.

questions.q: What is Obito's plan actually called?
a: The Eye of the Moon Plan
questions.note: Inherited from Madara, who inherited it from something older still.

questions.q: Who was the Ten-Tails' first jinchuriki?
questions.note: He sealed the beast into himself and became the moon's jailer.

questions.q: Which village did Killer B and the Eight-Tails belong to?
questions.note: Brother of the Fourth Raikage, and the only jinchuriki who was happy.

questions.q: What was Nagato's final act?
a: Reviving everyone he had killed in the Leaf
questions.note: Rinne Rebirth, and it cost him what was left of his life.
